lines.zh: 蹄子陷进沙里，翅膀半张着保持平衡。
lines.en: Hooves sink in the sand; my wings stay half-open for balance.

lines.zh: 沿着山脊走，风一托就想离地。
lines.en: I walk the ridge line, one gust away from taking off.

lines.zh: 前爪是鹰爪，后腿是马腿，走起来别扭。
lines.en: Eagle talons in front, horse legs behind, an awkward gait.

lines.zh: 我贴着崖壁走，鹰眼盯着下面的羊群。
lines.en: I hug the cliff wall, eagle eyes fixed on the sheep below.

lines.zh: 沙丘一脚深一脚浅，尾羽扫出痕迹。
lines.en: Dune by dune, my tail feathers sweep a trail behind me.

lines.zh: 收起翅膀走两步，还是觉得天上舒服。
lines.en: Wings folded for two steps, yet the sky still suits me better.

lines.zh: 马蹄踏碎碎石，爪尖扣住岩缝。
lines.en: My hooves crack the gravel, my talons hook the rock seams.

lines.zh: 走这一段是为了助跑，不是散步。
lines.en: This stretch is a run-up, not a stroll.

lines.zh: 我绕着巢边转，确认没有东西靠近。
lines.en: I circle my nest's edge, checking that nothing draws near.

lines.zh: 饥饿让我低下头，在沙里找活物。
lines.en: Hunger bends my head down, hunting the sand for movement.

lines.zh: 翅膀擦过灌木，叶子被风带起来。
lines.en: My wings brush the scrub and the leaves lift in my wake.

lines.zh: 半鹰半马，走路的姿势谁也不像。
lines.en: Half eagle, half horse, my walk resembles neither.

lines.zh: 我在坡上停了停，爪下石块滚落。
lines.en: I pause on the slope; a stone rolls from under my claw.

lines.zh: 高空盘旋太久了，落下来歇一会儿。
lines.en: I've circled too long up high; time to rest my wings.

lines.zh: 鹰首转向风声，马耳却朝另一边。
lines.en: My eagle head turns to the wind, my horse ears elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我理了理胸前的羽毛，一根根压平。
lines.en: I preen the feathers on my chest, pressing each one flat.

lines.zh: 这具身体一半想飞，一半想跑。
lines.en: Half of this body wants to fly, half wants to run.

lines.zh: 悬崖边的气流正好，我张开翅膀试了试。
lines.en: The updraft at the cliff is perfect; I test it with open wings.

lines.zh: 从高空摔下来过，可我从没受过伤。
lines.en: I've fallen from the sky before and never once been hurt.

lines.zh: 狮鹫的血统让我瞧不上地面的猎物。
lines.en: Griffin blood makes ground prey look beneath me.

lines.zh: 我盯着太阳，眼睛一点也不刺痛。
lines.en: I stare into the sun and my eyes do not water.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩了一下，赶走落在羽尖的苍蝇。
lines.en: A tail flick chases flies off my feather tips.

lines.zh: 马的那半在打盹，鹰的那半还醒着。
lines.en: The horse half dozes; the eagle half stays awake.

lines.zh: 风从山那边来，带着雪和松脂味。
lines.en: Wind comes off the mountains, smelling of snow and resin.

lines.zh: 巢里的羽毛垫得厚，我回去踩了两脚。
lines.en: My nest is thick with feathers; I stamp it down twice.

lines.zh: 我在等一个敢靠近的傻瓜。
lines.en: I am waiting for some fool to come closer.

lines.zh: 天空是我的地盘，落地只是暂歇。
lines.en: The sky is my domain; landing is only a pause.

lines.zh: 我在石头上磨了磨鹰喙。
lines.en: I whet my beak on the stone.

lines.zh: 鹰眼把你从头到脚扫了一遍。
lines.en: My eagle eyes scan you from head to toe.

lines.zh: 你身上有兔子的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: You smell of rabbit. I can tell from here.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，像在称量一顿饭。
lines.en: I tilt my head, weighing you like a meal.

lines.zh: 别伸手，鹰喙比你想的快。
lines.en: Don't reach out; my beak is faster than you think.

lines.zh: 你是来喂我的，还是来当饭的？
lines.en: Are you here to feed me, or to be my meal?

lines.zh: 我的影子从你头上掠过，你抬头了。
lines.en: My shadow crosses above you, and you look up.

lines.zh: 马的眼睛温和，鹰的眼睛不是。
lines.en: The horse eyes are gentle. The eagle eyes are not.

lines.zh: 我在数你几步能跑到树下。
lines.en: I'm counting how many steps you need to reach that tree.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西晃了晃，我盯住了。
lines.en: Something in your hand moves, and my gaze locks on.

lines.zh: 驯服我的人得先找到兔子脚。
lines.en: Whoever tames me must find a rabbit's foot first.

lines.zh: 你站得太直了，猎物不会这样站。
lines.en: You stand too upright; prey never stands like that.

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，是鹰唳混着马嘶。
lines.en: I growl, an eagle's cry tangled with a horse's whinny.

lines.zh: 披甲的主人骑上来时，我会认他。
lines.en: When my armored rider mounts, I will know him.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我的羽毛松了下来。
lines.en: You step back, and my feathers settle.

lines.zh: 你的帽子上沾了兔毛。
lines.en: There is rabbit fur on your hat.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕了一圈才落下。
lines.en: I circled above you once before landing.

lines.zh: 抬头的动作太慢，我早看见了。
lines.en: You looked up too slowly. I saw it coming.

lines.zh: 你的手一直藏在背后。
lines.en: Your hand has stayed behind your back.

lines.zh: 鹰的那半想扑，马的那半稳住了。
lines.en: The eagle half wants to lunge. The horse half holds.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰上的鞍，认得那东西。
lines.en: I stare at the saddle on your hip. I know what it is.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛挡了一下，可还是疼。
lines.en: Feathers soften the blow, but it still hurts.

lines.zh: 谁准你碰我的翅膀？
lines.en: Who gave you leave to touch my wings?

lines.zh: 我退了两步，爪子在沙上抓出沟。
lines.en: I back two steps, talons gouging the sand.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我从高处摔下来都没事。
lines.en: This much? I've fallen from far higher unharmed.

lines.zh: 我的鹰首转过来，眼睛红了。
lines.en: My eagle head turns, eyes going red.

lines.zh: 马的那半想跑，鹰的那半想打。
lines.en: The horse half wants to flee, the eagle half to fight.

lines.zh: 羽毛落了一地，我记着这笔。
lines.en: Feathers litter the ground; I'll remember this.

lines.zh: 你打中了骨头的接缝。
lines.en: You struck the seam between my bones.

lines.zh: 我唳了一声，山壁回了三声。
lines.en: I scream once and the cliff answers three times.

lines.zh: 再一下，我就不会只是警告了。
lines.en: One more and I'll stop warning you.

lines.zh: 兔子脚！你从哪儿弄来的？
lines.en: A rabbit's foot! Where did you get that?

lines.zh: 那只脚还在晃，我的瞳孔缩了。
lines.en: The foot still swings, and my pupils narrow.

lines.zh: 我低下头，鹰喙几乎碰到你的手。
lines.en: I lower my head, beak almost touching your hand.

lines.zh: 为了这个，我愿意收起爪子。
lines.en: For that, I am willing to sheath my talons.

lines.zh: 再举高一点，我看不清。
lines.en: Hold it higher; I can't see it clearly.

lines.zh: 兔毛的味道让我忘了饥饿。
lines.en: The smell of rabbit fur makes me forget my hunger.

lines.zh: 你在用一只脚换一头坐骑。
lines.en: You're trading one foot for a mount.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭你的肩膀，羽毛蹭乱了。
lines.en: I nuzzle your shoulder and ruffle my own feathers.

lines.zh: 这东西比金子香，比肉更让我听话。
lines.en: It smells better than gold and tames me faster than meat.

lines.zh: 我的爪子松开了，蹄子往前挪。
lines.en: My talons loosen and my hooves shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 只要再给一次，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give it once more and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 你把兔子脚藏起来，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: Hide the rabbit's foot and my head snaps up.

lines.zh: 我低声叫，像在讨要第二只。
lines.en: I call softly, begging for a second one.

lines.zh: 驯服我的法子，原来这么小。
lines.en: The way to tame me turns out to be this small.

lines.zh: 那只脚还带着土，新鲜。
lines.en: That foot still has soil on it. Fresh.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，蹄印很深。
lines.en: I shift forward half a step. Deep hoofprints.

lines.zh: 你再放低一点，我就认你。
lines.en: Lower it a little more and I will accept you.

lines.zh: 撞上我的翅膀，你被弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my wing and bounce right off.

lines.zh: 我这副身板，站着不动也像堵墙。
lines.en: Built like this, I'm a wall even standing still.

lines.zh: 别从后面挤，马蹄会先动。
lines.en: Don't shove from behind; my hooves move first.

lines.zh: 羽毛蹭过你的脸，硬得像铁片。
lines.en: My feathers scrape your face, hard as iron plates.

lines.zh: 我侧身让了让，只让出半步。
lines.en: I shift aside, giving you half a step.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，那里是鹰的骨架。
lines.en: You strike my chest, where the eagle's bones are.

lines.zh: 我甩尾扫了你一下，算提醒。
lines.en: My tail sweeps you once, as a warning.

lines.zh: 路这么宽，你偏往爪子上踩。
lines.en: The path is wide, yet you step on my talons.

lines.zh: 我鸣了一声，往崖边挪开。
lines.en: I cry out once and shuffle toward the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 四十点血量的身体，撞起来很实在。
lines.en: Forty points of health makes a solid thing to hit.

lines.zh: 我用鹰喙替她梳后颈的羽毛。
lines.en: I groom her nape feathers with my beak.

lines.zh: 两头骏鹰在崖上对鸣，声音传得很远。
lines.en: Two hippogryphs call from the cliff, carrying far.

lines.zh: 我把捕来的猎物放在她爪边。
lines.en: I lay my catch at her talons.

lines.zh: 她展开翅膀，我跟着展开，一比大小。
lines.en: She spreads her wings; I match her, comparing span.

lines.zh: 我们在高空绕圈，一圈比一圈低。
lines.en: We circle high, each loop lower than the last.

lines.zh: 巢要垫得软，我去叼干草和羽毛。
lines.en: The nest must be soft; I fetch dry grass and feathers.

lines.zh: 她碰了碰我的喙，没有躲。
lines.en: She touches my beak and does not pull away.

lines.zh: 半鹰半马的后代，会先学会什么？
lines.en: Half eagle, half horse, which will our young learn first?

lines.zh: 我守在她巢外，谁靠近就瞪谁。
lines.en: I guard outside her nest, glaring at anything that nears.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，两对翅膀收得整齐。
lines.en: We stand side by side, two pairs of wings folded neat.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓起一块石头，又扔了。
lines.en: I pick up a stone in my talons and drop it.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了，我低头叼起来插回去。
lines.en: A feather falls; I pick it up and tuck it back.

lines.zh: 这箱子里装的都是我的东西。
lines.en: Everything in this chest is mine.

lines.zh: 皮革蹭在爪心，有点滑。
lines.en: The leather is slick against my talon pads.

lines.zh: 我叼起兔脚，舍不得咽下去。
lines.en: I carry the rabbit's foot, unwilling to swallow it.

lines.zh: 一块亮石头，够我玩半天。
lines.en: One bright stone keeps me busy half the day.

lines.zh: 我试着把鞍驮起来，歪了。
lines.en: I try to carry the saddle and it slides sideways.

lines.zh: 箱扣夹住了我的爪尖。
lines.en: The chest latch pinches my talon tip.

lines.zh: 我不捡破烂，只捡会发光的。
lines.en: I don't collect junk, only things that shine.

lines.zh: 叼在嘴里，飞起来才不占地方。
lines.en: Carried in my beak, it takes no room in flight.

lines.zh: 下面有只羊落单了，我收翅。
lines.en: A sheep strays from the flock; I fold my wings.

lines.zh: 那头猪跑得慢，就是它了。
lines.en: That pig runs slow; it will do.

lines.zh: 我饿得够久，目光落在你身上。
lines.en: I've been hungry long enough; my eyes settle on you.

lines.zh: 兔子的耳朵动了一下，被我看穿了。
lines.en: A rabbit's ear twitches, and I've marked it.

lines.zh: 猎物还没发现我从背光处下来。
lines.en: The prey hasn't noticed me dropping from the sun.

lines.zh: 这只鸡太瘦，可我不挑。
lines.en: That chicken is thin, but I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 我盯上了一头小牛，母牛在附近。
lines.en: I've marked a calf, and the cow is close by.

lines.zh: 一爪下去就是五点伤害。
lines.en: One talon strike lands five points of damage.

lines.zh: 那头驴驮着货，正好当晚餐。
lines.en: That donkey carries a load; perfect for dinner.

lines.zh: 我从云后面滑出来，选定了目标。
lines.en: I slide out from behind a cloud, target chosen.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，爪尖在沙上划。
lines.en: I crouch low, talons scoring the sand.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开一半，随时能扑。
lines.en: Wings half-spread, ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，不给你正面对冲。
lines.en: I circle to your flank, denying you a head-on clash.

lines.zh: 眼睛不眨，脖子却微微后缩。
lines.en: My eyes don't blink, but my neck draws back.

lines.zh: 尾羽绷紧，像拉满的弓。
lines.en: My tail feathers tense like a drawn bow.

lines.zh: 我先吓你，看你会不会跑。
lines.en: I bluff first, to see whether you run.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，让我多等了一会儿。
lines.en: That raised shield makes me wait a moment longer.

lines.zh: 风从背后推我，这正是我要的。
lines.en: The wind pushes at my back, exactly what I wanted.

lines.zh: 我的影子把你盖住了。
lines.en: My shadow swallows you whole.

lines.zh: 一声鹰唳，然后才是俯冲。
lines.en: One eagle scream, then the dive.

lines.zh: 前爪扣住你的肩，后蹄跟上。
lines.en: My foretalons clamp your shoulder, hind hooves follow.

lines.zh: 鹰喙啄下来，快得看不清。
lines.en: My beak stabs down too fast to follow.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇在你脸上，沙全扬起来了。
lines.en: A wingbeat hits your face and the sand flies up.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，整只压下去。
lines.en: I spring up and drop with all my weight.

lines.zh: 抓一下就走，蹄子顺带踹一脚。
lines.en: One rake and I'm gone, hooves adding a kick.

lines.zh: 爪子划开你的护甲，声音刺耳。
lines.en: My talons score your armor with a grating shriek.

lines.zh: 我从上方掠过，只留三道痕。
lines.en: I sweep overhead and leave three lines behind.

lines.zh: 你挡得住喙，挡不住蹄。
lines.en: You can block the beak, not the hooves.

lines.zh: 这一扑带着高空的全部冲力。
lines.en: This pounce carries every bit of my dive.

lines.zh: 我咬住你，把你往崖边拖。
lines.en: I seize you and drag you toward the cliff.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上空落下来，翅膀还没收。
lines.en: I drop over the dunes, wings still open.

lines.zh: 山地里多了一头骏鹰，风变了。
lines.en: A hippogryph has come to the mountains; the wind shifts.

lines.zh: 沙子被我的落地吹开一圈。
lines.en: My landing blows a ring in the sand.

lines.zh: 鹰首抬起，先看天，再看地。
lines.en: My eagle head rises, sky first, ground second.

lines.zh: 我从巢里出来，羽毛上还挂着草。
lines.en: I step from the nest with grass stuck in my feathers.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠够热，正合我的脾气。
lines.en: This desert is hot enough for my temper.

lines.zh: 狮鹫与马的血，在这里重新落地。
lines.en: Griffin and horse blood touches ground again.

lines.zh: 我一落地就先找能吃的活物。
lines.en: The moment I land, I look for something living to eat.

lines.zh: 崖顶的石头被我的爪子磨出印子。
lines.en: My claws wear marks into the cliff-top stone.

lines.zh: 又一头掠食者住进了这片山地。
lines.en: Another predator has moved into these mountains.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛烧卷了，闻起来像烤肉。
lines.en: My feathers curl and smell like roasting meat.

lines.zh: 摔不坏，这高度对我来说不算什么。
lines.en: Falls can't hurt me; this height means nothing.

lines.zh: 水灌进羽毛，我扑腾着往岸边爬。
lines.en: Water floods my feathers; I thrash toward the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的沙埋了我半个身子。
lines.en: The blast throws sand that half covers me.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在翅膀上，我歪着飞。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my wing; I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 那股魔力钻进骨头，我的羽毛立起来了。
lines.en: That magic seeps into my bones and my feathers stand.

lines.zh: 饿到现在，我看什么都像猎物。
lines.en: Starved this long, everything looks like prey.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我只麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I only go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，翅膀扇不动。
lines.en: There's no wind in the void; my wings find nothing.
